notes: Stitcher: new tick box 'Stitch when the scan finishes', under the Scan button. With it ticked, one press of Scan does both: when the scan is done, the ticked groups (those at or above 'Auto-tick groups from') are stitched straight away. You don't look the groups over first, and groups that have to be re-encoded are stitched too without the usual question. Where the files go is settled when you press Scan. Untick the box while the scan is running to call the stitching off. It is off unless you tick it.
